title: AUTH RENDER CHAIN BREAKDOWN

root_chain.behavior: Mounts AuthProvider and always renders children.
Owns identity and session state only; starts /auth/me as a non-blocking background probe from useEffect.
Renders login content immediately unless already authenticated; authenticated users are redirected to /dashboard without a full-page spinner.
Renders protected children for authenticated/checking states and only redirects when status is unauthenticated.

render_order_changes.before: CapabilityStateProvider -> ModuleAccessProvider -> AdapterAccessProvider -> AuthGuard -> ConsoleShell -> PermissionRouteGuard
render_order_changes.after: AuthGuard -> CapabilityStateProvider -> ModuleAccessProvider -> AdapterAccessProvider -> ConsoleShell -> PermissionRouteGuard
render_order_changes.impact: Capability, module, and adapter providers no longer mount when AuthGuard has already determined the session is unauthenticated.

background_work.ui_failure_mode: 401 clears session; non-401 failures do not render an error screen or block children.

background_work.trigger: useEffect after protected tree render and authenticated identity availability
background_work.ui_failure_mode: fallback/degraded provider state, no full-page auth spinner.

blocking_states_removed: AuthProvider error screen caused by /auth/me failure
Capability provider loading inherited from AuthProvider checking state
